name: Screen Reader Accessibility – WCAG, Text-to-Speech & AI Accessibility Fixes
author: JExtensions Store

sections.description:
Make your WordPress website fully accessible and WCAG-compliant in minutes.
Screen Reader Accessibility adds essential tools such as text-to-speech, high contrast modes, dark mode, dyslexic fonts, enlarged cursor, reading guides, zoom, ARIA fixes, and AI-powered accessibility improvements using ChatGPT.

It helps fix the most common accessibility issues automatically (missing ALT text, incorrect heading order, low contrast, missing labels and ARIA roles), improving compliance and usability for visually impaired users.

The plugin helps visually impaired users navigate your website with ease, meets accessibility regulations (WCAG / ADA), and improves overall user experience for everyone.

Screen Reader Accessibility is ideal for users searching for:

  • WordPress accessibility plugin
  • WCAG and ADA compliance tools
  • Screen reader / text-to-speech solution
  • AI accessibility fixes (alt text, headings, ARIA)
  • Accessibility plugin for visually impaired visitors
  • Dyslexic font and contrast adjustments
  • Fix accessibility issues automatically

More than 50 languages are supported through multiple audio engines, allowing your visitors to listen to your content naturally and clearly. The voices of the browser (Web Speech) read the whole text with no limit and are chosen automatically for the language of the page.

🚀 Try Screen Reader Live on WordPress Playground 🚀

Check the PRO version including all features at:
https://test.storejextensions.org/wpscreenreader/

🚀 Download the PRO version with all features: 🚀

Check the product page of the PRO version with all features:
https://storejextensions.org/extensions/screen_reader.html

Why Choose Screen Reader Accessibility?

• Complete accessibility suite with WCAG-compliant tools
• AI-powered repairs for alt text, headings, contrast and more
• Text-to-speech in 50+ languages, with no limit on the text when it uses the voices of the browser
• Advanced toolbar with themes, readability tools and color controls
• Supports all themes, builders and caching plugins
• Lightweight, fast and easy to configure
• Helps sites meet WCAG and ADA accessibility requirements

⚠️FREE vs PRO

FREE VERSION:

  • Text-to-speech with no limit on the length of the text using the voices of the browser (Web Speech)
  • Audio engines of the services (Responsive Voice and others) reading the first 300 characters of the text
  • Basic accessibility toolbar
  • Font size controls and up to 3 contrast modes
  • Highlight links, stop animations and enlarged cursor buttons
  • Outline focus for keyboard navigation
  • Toolbar position, templates and minimized toolbar settings
  • Essential features only

PRO VERSION (FULL ACCESSIBILITY SUITE):

  • AI-powered accessibility fixes (OpenAI or Google Gemini)
  • Generate missing alt text
  • Fix heading order
  • Fix low-contrast text
  • Add missing ARIA roles
  • Add missing form labels
  • Fix focus order
  • Dyslexic font transformation
  • Dark mode
  • Read mode
  • Page zoom
  • Gray hues
  • Reading guide
  • Hide images / hide videos
  • Custom text & background colors
  • Visitor profiles with one click: vision impaired, dyslexia friendly, focus and attention, motor impaired, seizure safe
  • Color overlay and reading mask
  • Accessibility statement as a link or a file, skip to contents link
  • Advanced toolbar themes
  • Unlimited text-to-speech with every audio engine across 50+ languages
  • High-performance audio engines
  • Full WCAG compliance tools

🚀 Get the PRO version here 🚀

Check the product page of the PRO version here:
https://storejextensions.org/extensions/screen_reader.html

👉 The FREE version is designed for basic accessibility only. The PRO version provides a complete WCAG/ADA compliance toolkit.

🚀 Key Features

🗣️ Text-to-Speech (50+ Languages)

Reads the page, or only the selected text, aloud. The default engine uses the voices of the browser (Web Speech), picks the best voice for the language of the page automatically and lets visitors choose another one from a menu, with no limit on the length of the text. Multiple high-quality audio engines of the services are available too, in the FREE version they read the first 300 characters of the text.

🔍 WCAG & ADA Compliance Tools

Automated improvements plus manual accessibility options.

⚡ AI Accessibility Fixes (OpenAI or Google Gemini, PRO)

Automatically:
– generates missing ALT text
– fixes heading hierarchy
– identifies low-contrast text
– adds missing ARIA roles
– repairs form labels
– improves focus order

🎨 Accessibility Toolbar

Powerful and customizable toolbar with:
– dyslexic font
– contrast modes
– dark mode
– big cursor
– hide images
– reading guide
– font size controls
– zoom controls
– highlight links
– stop animations
– color overlay and reading mask
– one click profiles for vision impaired, dyslexia friendly, focus and attention, motor impaired and seizure safe visitors

💬 Read-on-Hover

Reads blocks of text when hovered with the mouse.

🖼 Accessibility for Images & Videos

Hide visually complex media or load alternates for accessibility.

🧩 Respects Your Theme

Sizes, headings and line heights of your design are not changed until a visitor uses a button, and they are restored on reset.

📚 Saves User Preferences

Stores user accessibility preferences between page loads.

⚙️ Lightweight & Compatible

Works with all themes, builders and caching plugins.

External services

The default text to speech uses the speech synthesis of the browser of the visitor, no data is sent to any server by this plugin.

The optional audio engines of the services (Audio tab of the settings) read the text through the service that you select. When one of them is selected, the text that is read aloud is sent to that service: Responsive Voice (responsivevoice.org, terms: https://responsivevoice.org/terms/ and privacy policy: https://responsivevoice.org/privacy-policy/), Google Translate, iSpeech, Inforobo, TTSMP3 and TextToMP3, through a proxy of this plugin on your own site. The script of Responsive Voice is loaded from the plugin folder or from code.responsivevoice.org (setting “Responsive Voice script loading”).

PRO version only: when the generation of the missing alt text of the images is enabled, the image is sent to the AI provider that you select, OpenAI (openai.com, terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use and privacy policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy) or Google Gemini (ai.google.dev, terms: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms), using your own API key, which is stored in your database and is never sent to the browser.

The plugin shows links to the website of its author, storejextensions.org, in the settings page and in this description. No data is sent by those links until you click them.
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate the plugin.
  2. A fixed accessibility toolbar will appear on the frontend.
  3. Configure additional options in Screen Reader settings, in the admin menu.
  4. If upgrading to PRO, install the PRO version: the FREE version steps aside and your settings are kept.

For the PRO installer, go to:
Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin → Choose File → Install Now
sections.faq:
Is Screen Reader Accessibility WCAG compliant?

Yes. The plugin includes many tools required for WCAG/ADA compliance, such as text-to-speech, contrast modes, font adjustments, ARIA roles, headings fixes and more.

Does the plugin support text-to-speech in multiple languages?

Yes. Over 50 languages are supported and PRO users gain access to advanced audio engines.

Is there a limit on the length of the text that is read aloud?

With the voices of the browser (Web Speech, the default engine) there is no limit: the whole page or the selected text is read. The audio engines of the services read the first 300 characters of the text in the FREE version, the PRO version reads the full text with every engine.

Which voices does the default text to speech use?

The voices installed in the browser or in the device of the visitor, so the languages available depend on their browser and operating system. The plugin picks the best voice available for the language of the page.

Will Screen Reader Accessibility work with Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg and any theme?

Yes. It is fully theme-independent and works with any builder.

What does the AI integration (PRO) do?

It analyzes your site and automatically fixes accessibility problems such as missing alt text, poor contrast, wrong heading order, and missing labels.

Can this plugin help visually impaired users navigate my site?

Absolutely. That’s the main purpose: to improve accessibility and usability for visually impaired visitors.

Is the plugin lightweight?

Yes. The core plugin is optimized and loads minimal resources.

  • Security: alt text of the images generated by the AI is now requested server side, the API key is never exposed to the browser
  • Security: the audio proxies are protected by a signed token and every option is passed to the page with json_encode
  • New Web Speech API audio engine with automatic choice of the best available voice, rate and pitch settings and an optional voice menu for the visitors
